turns.replyText:
Show me your two best value-for-money options and compare them.

Totally get wanting the best value, especially on a budget. With that in mind, two excellent “bang for your buck” roses from our lineup are:

Parfuma® Earth Angel
Amazing Grace™ (the rose, not the tulip)

Both are own-root roses that come back year after year, so you’re investing once in a long‑term shrub, not a one‑season plant.

Here’s a quick comparison focused on value:

• Overall feel

Parfuma® Earth Angel: Very romantic, old-fashioned look with peony‑like blooms. Great if you like a lush, classic cottage‑garden style. Described as a “true perennial investment” that returns yearly.
Amazing Grace™: Soft ruffled petals with a gentle blush of pink. A reliable garden workhorse that “comes back stronger every season.” Great if you want something beautiful but very steady and dependable.

• Fragrance

Parfuma® Earth Angel: Highlighted for its unforgettable fragrance, so it’s the better choice if scent is a big deal to you.
Amazing Grace™: More about overall performance and pretty color than powerhouse fragrance.

• Long‑term value

Both are own‑root, perennial roses that come back every year and improve with age, so you avoid replanting like you would with annuals.
Parfuma® Earth Angel leans a bit more toward “special, romantic, highly scented showpiece.”
Amazing Grace™ leans a bit more toward “steady, reliable performer with soft, classic color.”
